verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs describe remote-daemon control from app.humanlayer.com (including from a phone), live multiplayer session viewing with presence/read-only viewing, and task/session history — all suggesting real-time visibility into agent activity. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated live status/log stream or dashboard showing granular agent state (e.g., current tool call, progress bar) beyond session/task views. missing for 10: explicit real-time status/log streaming documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of live monitoring UX.
